name: Cazzo Film
summary: Historic Berlin all-male erotica studio acclaimed for gritty artistic realism, authentic everyday German performers, and cultural cinema awards.
ranking_rationale: Genuine indie European grit—lightyears removed from glossy plastic studios; weighed against raw vintage video aesthetic divides clean-glamour viewers.
